name: When should I consider building a detached ADU instead of expanding my main home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider building a detached ADU instead of expanding my main home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider building a detached ADU if you require a separate, private living space that is distinct from your main home. This is ideal for rental income, housing extended family while maintaining independence, or creating a dedicated workspace without impacting the primary residence's layout or privacy. It's also a strong option if your property has sufficient space and zoning allows for a new separate structure, and if adding onto your main home would be too disruptive or functionally awkward.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a detached ADU for separate, private living space, rental income, or housing family independently, especially if property space and zoning permit a new structure.
